title: An octopus jet
hook: Moving water can move an animal.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The two panels show water entering the mantle and then leaving through the siphon. Expelling water contributes to jet propulsion; an octopus can also move in other ways. The arrows indicate a simplified direction, not a measurement.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: An octopus draws water into its mantle and then pushes water out through a siphon. What helps propel it in the opposite direction?

claims.text: Moving water can move an animal. An octopus draws water into its mantle and then pushes water out through a siphon. What helps propel it in the opposite direction?
